spread_convention: positive spread_line = home team favoured by that many points (verified empirically in results/market.json convention_check)

open_column_status.note: The only opening-line archive in the repository covers WSGT 2021 spread/total (origination-lab/data/raw/initial_lines.csv), which is outside our 2023-2026 origination window. No official body publishes historical opening odds. Open columns are therefore blank by policy (flag PS-F-01).

verification_policy.verified-official: digit-for-digit from an official NFL page/gamebook, with URL and date
verification_policy.archived-unverified: third-party archive value retained for computation, never presented as verified
verification_policy.blank-missing-no-source: no source exists; value left blank and flagged
verification_policy.ours-reproducible: our own model output, reproducible from named repo files
verification_policy.computed: arithmetic over stated inputs; inherits weakest input status
